newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH CLOSING SHARE MARKET REPORT.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH CLOSING SHARE MARKET REPORT.

text.p: Dutch shares end Tuesday at a fresh closing high, the second in two days, but well short of a new intra-day high after coming close to breaking through the 600 level on AEX share index for the first time ever.
The index closed 0.49 points higher at 597.59, after climbing to 599.69 in the opening hours of the session, buoyed by another record high closing overnight on Wall Street.

Dealers said market makers were blocking off the way to 600 on the AEX, selling into strength in the hope of holding the index below 600 and thus avoiding covering positions following heavy options expirations at that level on Friday.
